summary.text: Susan Rubio was elected to the California State Senate in 2018 to represent District 22 and was reelected in 2022, according to her Senate biography.

paragraphs.text: Before the Senate she was a public school teacher for 20 years in the Baldwin Park and Monrovia school districts and an elected official for 13 years in the City of Baldwin Park.
She was born in Juarez, Mexico, earned a bachelor's and a master's degree in education from Azusa Pacific University, and lives in Baldwin Park, California.
